boards.name: East 57th Street Partners
boards.comment: VERIFIED 2026-08-25 in a real browser: the firm's site is e57partners.com (east57th.com does not resolve; e57partners.com returns 403 to non-browser clients). Its Careers link is a JobDiva candidate portal SPA that lists client mandates without login (12 rows on 2026-08-25, including Executive Search: CTO/CFO/CEO, all dated 03/19/2025). Not enableable yet: rows use Details buttons, not anchors, so JSON-LD, selectors, and the anchor scan all yield zero; needs a JobDiva-specific extractor that reads the list and builds detail URLs. Listings observed were stale (5 months), so low priority.

boards.name: Korn Ferry
boards.comment: VERIFIED 2026-08-25: /executive-search/opportunities is 404. The public board is jobs.candidate.kornferry.com/jobs/ (Loopworks): the static page is a search form only and results load via a Kendo grid after a search is submitted. The capability object forbids form submission by design, so this board cannot be scanned without a policy change. Keep disabled.

boards.name: Heidrick & Struggles
boards.comment: VERIFIED 2026-08-25: no public list of client searches. /en/opportunities is 404; /en/careers is the firm's own staff hiring page (Workday) and leaders.heidrick.com is a registration-only candidate intake. Nothing to scan. Keep disabled.

boards.name: Spencer Stuart
boards.comment: VERIFIED 2026-08-25: no public list of client searches. /executive-search/opportunities is 404; only the firm's own Workday careers page and a login-gated candidate registration portal exist. Nothing to scan. Keep disabled.

boards.name: Russell Reynolds Associates
boards.comment: VERIFIED 2026-08-25: no public list of client searches. /en/opportunities is 404; careers-with-our-clients is a resume-submission CTA page with no listings (refers candidates to AESC BlueSteps). Nothing to scan. Keep disabled.

_comment: Exec-search firm boards for the exec-generic adapter. All five were verified on 2026-08-25: none exposes a scannable public list today. Retained-search firms (Heidrick, Spencer Stuart, Russell Reynolds) publish no client mandates; Korn Ferry needs a form submit the capability object forbids; East 57th is a JobDiva SPA that needs its own extractor. Every entry stays disabled; a wrong listUrl fails closed (CONFIG_INVALID) and never reaches the network.
